# VigyanPrep (vigyanprep.com)

> India's #1 Premier Research Entrance Examination Platform for IISER IAT, NISER NEST, IISc, CMI & ISI.

## Overview
VigyanPrep provides NTA-standard Computer Based Test (CBT) series, verified past year question (PYQ) archives with step-by-step solutions, and AI-powered analytics for science research entrance aspirants in India.

## Target Examinations
- **IISER IAT**: Indian Institutes of Science Education and Research Aptitude Test
- **NISER NEST**: National Entrance Screening Test for NISER Bhubaneswar & UM-DAE CEBS Mumbai
- **IISc BS Research**: Indian Institute of Science Bachelor of Science Program
- **CMI**: Chennai Mathematical Institute Entrance Exam
- **ISI**: Indian Statistical Institute Entrance Exam

## Key Official Web Portals
- Main Platform: https://vigyanprep.com
- Past Year Question Archives: https://vigyanprep.com/pyq
- Official Test Series Packages: https://vigyanprep.com/tests
- About & Mentors: https://vigyanprep.com/about
- Student Live CBT Test Portal: https://test.vigyanprep.com
- Student Authentication & Login: https://auth.vigyanprep.com

## Key Features
- NTA Standard CBT Interface (Matches exact IISER & NISER exam screen layout, timers, and question palettes).
- 1,450+ Verified PYQ Solutions in Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, and Biology.
- Real-time All-India Percentile Ranks & Subject-wise Intuition Analytics.
- Curated by IISER, NISER & IISc Scholars.
